criteria_results.text: A pending protected approval appears immediately as an actionable card in the originating session.
criteria_results.notes: Previously confirmed in the rebuilt debug app with an inline actionable approval card.

criteria_results.text: Approve and deny both resolve the exact pending approval.
criteria_results.notes: Approval decision actions were confirmed in the preceding manual smoke.

criteria_results.text: The bell badge count increments within approximately 30 seconds and the card is visible in the notification panel.
criteria_results.notes: The bell badge and inline card were confirmed in the preceding manual smoke.

criteria_results.text: A pending AgentApproval with sessionId matching the open agent session renders an inline actionable approval card in the real transcript composition; nonmatching approvals do not render there.
criteria_results.notes: The originating transcript displayed the matching request inline.

criteria_results.text: Activating a local notification payload for a pending approval selects Agents, opens the originating session, and targets the request.
criteria_results.notes: Approval notification routing was confirmed in the preceding debug-build smoke.

criteria_results.text: Approving a pending agent approval automatically resumes the originating session exactly once, carries the exact approval_id, and instructs the agent to retry the identical protected action once.
criteria_results.notes: The user confirmed the approval flow continued without a manual follow-up after the continuation repair.

criteria_results.text: Rejecting a pending agent approval automatically resumes the originating session exactly once and explicitly prevents the protected action from being performed.
criteria_results.notes: The final smoke exercised notification delivery, not rejection continuation.

criteria_results.text: A decision made while the originating session is working remains durably queued and dispatches exactly once after the session becomes idle.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by contract tests only in this smoke cycle.

criteria_results.text: After restart, recovery dispatches an already queued decided approval exactly once using the persisted originating session mapping.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by contract tests only in this smoke cycle.

criteria_results.text: An interactive session whose root has the server-owned explicit bypass marker may consume the exact protected delegation action without approval_id.
criteria_results.notes: The user explicitly reported that bypass mode worked.

criteria_results.text: The same interactive delegation in default permission mode remains pending and is forbidden without approval_id.
criteria_results.notes: Default-mode approval creation and resolution were exercised earlier in the same debug-build sequence.

criteria_results.text: The MCP approval tool reports bypass as not_required and delegation proceeds without forwarding an approval_id.
criteria_results.notes: Observed through the successful bypass-mode session smoke.

criteria_results.text: Agent sessions persist a dedicated server-owned explicit approval-bypass marker.
criteria_results.notes: Persistence detail is covered by contract tests.

criteria_results.text: A forced-bypass child under a default root remains subject to the external-content approval gate.
A delegated child under an explicit human-selected bypass root may proceed without approval_id without copying the marker onto the child.
criteria_results.notes: The user confirmed delegated bypass behavior.

criteria_results.text: A headless bypass root without explicit human provenance remains subject to the external-content approval gate.
The first successful unread-notification poll establishes a startup baseline without replaying native banners for notifications that were already unread.
criteria_results.notes: The final smoke created a new notification; it did not test launch replay.

criteria_results.text: A general AppNotification newly unread after startup emits exactly one routed native notification without duplicate polling delivery.
criteria_results.notes: The final prompt exercised an immediate agent notification rather than a persisted general notification row.

criteria_results.text: An immediate agent notification emits exactly one native notification, opens Agents when activated, and duplicate IDs do not increment or push again.
criteria_results.notes: The user reported PASS after the rebuilt app produced a red bell and macOS push from a harmless notification.send action.

process_issues.description: The API serial gate completed 4,436 assertions across 541 files, then its single reused Vitest fork exhausted even a 4 GB heap during teardown.
process_issues.detected_by: The full api_server run reported 541 passed files, 4,436 passed tests, and a V8 heap-out-of-memory worker error after the assertions completed.

suggested_follow_up: Retain the unified notification contracts and run the native banner smoke after any future notification-source changes.
